annotations.title: Get a program's points expiry rule

description: Returns one UAE loyalty program's published rule on when its points expire and, where the program publishes one, what a point is worth, each with the program's own source link and the date it was last checked. Where the program publishes no value per point, the result says so and gives no number.

slug.description: The program's identifier, as returned by list_programs.

name: get_program_expiry
